2021 Honda Civic Parts — OEM & Aftermarket

Catalog updated · Sep 2026·3 Engines·21 Categories·5,563 Parts·Change vehicle

Browse 5,563 parts for the 2021 Honda Civic. It was offered with 3 engines: 1.5L L4 Turbo, 2.0L L4 and 2.0L L4 Turbo.

Jump into Brake & Wheel Hub when that is the job; otherwise Engine, Body & Lamp Assembly, or another section below cover the rest of the 2021 Honda Civic.

Parts by Category

Belt Drive

47 parts · 3 subcategories · 12 brands Honda belt drive: spins the accessories — belt tensioner, belt and tensioner pulley.

Body & Lamp Assembly

544 parts · 55 subcategories · 18 brands Honda body & lamp assembly: covers tail lamp assembly, headlamp assembly and fog / driving lamp assembly.

Brake & Wheel Hub

1,197 parts · 27 subcategories · 54 brands Honda brake & wheel hub: covers brake pad, rotor & brake pad kit and rotor.

Cooling System

273 parts · 22 subcategories · 44 brands Honda cooling system: covers coolant / antifreeze, temperature sender / sensor and radiator.

Drivetrain

56 parts · 5 subcategories · 6 brands Honda drivetrain: covers cv axle, cv joint boot and cv intermediate shaft.

Electrical

122 parts · 11 subcategories · 25 brands Honda electrical: covers alternator / generator, speed sensor and battery.

Electrical Bulb & Socket

249 parts · 15 subcategories · 7 brands Honda electrical bulb & socket: covers headlamp bulb, back up / reverse lamp bulb and brake light bulb.

Electrical Connector

66 parts · 23 subcategories · 5 brands Honda electrical connector: covers radio connector, trailer connector and washer pump connector.

Electrical Switch & Relay

157 parts · 26 subcategories · 13 brands Honda electrical switch & relay: covers power window switch, oil pressure sender / switch and brake light switch.

Engine

601 parts · 62 subcategories · 59 brands Honda engine: covers oil, oil filter and timing chain guide / damper.

Exhaust & Emission

207 parts · 17 subcategories · 34 brands Honda exhaust & emission: covers oxygen (o2) sensor, mass air flow (maf) sensor and manifold pressure (map) sensor.

Fuel & Air

89 parts · 15 subcategories · 29 brands Honda fuel & air: meters fuel and air — air filter, fuel injector seal / o-ring and throttle body.

Heat & Air Conditioning

257 parts · 19 subcategories · 32 brands Honda heat & air conditioning: covers cabin air filter, blower motor and a/c refrigerant hose / line.

Ignition

92 parts · 6 subcategories · 17 brands Honda ignition: delivers spark at the right moment — ignition coil, crankshaft position sensor and camshaft position sensor.

Interior

432 parts · 13 subcategories · 11 brands Honda interior: covers cabin hardware — seat cover, window regulator & motor assembly and floor mat.

Steering

83 parts · 3 subcategories · 9 brands Honda steering: covers tie rod end, knuckle and rack and pinion bellow.

Suspension

297 parts · 12 subcategories · 19 brands Honda suspension: covers control arm, shock / strut and sway bar link.

Automatic Transmission

63 parts · 10 subcategories · 21 brands Honda automatic transmission: covers transmission fluid, transmission mount and filter.

Manual Transmission

43 parts · 10 subcategories · 12 brands Honda manual transmission: covers the manual gearbox and clutch system — clutch kit, transmission mount and manual transmission fluid.

Wheel

68 parts · 7 subcategories · 4 brands Honda wheel: covers lug nut, lug nut & lock kit and lug nut lock.

Wiper & Washer

361 parts · 6 subcategories · 16 brands Honda wiper & washer: keeps the glass clear — wiper blade, washer fluid reservoir cap and washer fluid reservoir.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which engines came in the 2021 Honda Civic?

The 2021 Honda Civic was offered with 1.5L L4 Turbo (2,229 parts), 2.0L L4 (2,118 parts) and 2.0L L4 Turbo (1,216 parts). Confirm the engine under the hood before ordering.

How many parts fit the 2021 Honda Civic?

5,563 parts fit the 2021 Honda Civic across 21 categories on AutoFactsDB.com.

Which part categories are largest for the 2021 Honda Civic?

The largest categories for the 2021 Honda Civic are Brake & Wheel Hub (1,197 parts), Engine (601 parts) and Body & Lamp Assembly (544 parts).

Do I need my engine when shopping for 2021 Honda Civic parts?

Yes. The 2021 Honda Civic had 3 engines, and many parts are engine-specific. Every category page shows fitment by engine — filter to yours before you buy.
